currentRoundInspection.scope: Old (Great) Hermitage exterior, independent old_hermitage/Q4092958: exact long irregular native main block with three riverfront tiers, round-arched ground windows/rustication, five central high arched piano bays, alternating curved/triangular window pediments, pale pilasters/cornices/dentils, low faceted green metal hip roof and small chimneys. Include the separately mapped elevated covered gallery over Winter Canal, with segmental open canal arch, six upper arched windows per side, balcony rail and curved faceted metal roof. Only two mapped building records replaced; preserve Small/New Hermitage, Theatre, independent road bridge, canal/water/quays/roads. No furnished collections, copied relief/sculpture/lettering, crowds or hidden plant.
